pages.text: Build the 3×3×3 shell with Industrial Water Intake Casings and place the controller at the center of one outside face with its front facing away from the shell. Casings extend behind it; use a horizontal right-click on a controller face to set its direction. The bottom-center block must touch a body containing at least 400 connected source-water blocks. The intake pumps up to 8,000 mB/t, uses 0.25 FE per mB, and stores 128,000 mB. World water is not consumed. Right-click the controller to view formation, water count, flow, tank, and energy.

The alpha refreshes its bounded water count every 100 ticks. River and ocean speed bonus and unloaded-chunk filtering are not available with the pinned Horizon hooks. Connect a Fluid Conduit to the controller's output capability and supply FE.
